declarations.description:
Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

Codemode: `tools.read(args)` resolves to `string | { data: string; mimeType: string; note: string; type: "image"; }`.
declarations.name: read

anyOf.description: Maximum number of lines to read
Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

declarations.description:
Search the web and return a concise answer with source URLs. For multi-page deep research, use intelli_research instead.

Codemode: `tools.intelli_search(args)` resolves to `{ schemaVersion, operation, operationId, outcome, text, details, summary, sources, cache, related, counts: { candidates, fetched, extracted, used, late, failed, cancelled, effectivePageConcurrency }, timing: { startedUtc, elapsedMs, allWorkSettledMs, summaryReadyMs?, cutoffMs?, abortToSettledMs? }, accounting: { attempts, observedAttempts, missingAttempts, tokens, reportedCost, estimatedCost, missingTokenFields, costComplete, parentDelivery }, attempts, deadline: { enabled, reason, minimumMet } }`.
declarations.name: intelli_search

declarations.description:
Extract query-relevant content from a web page. Compresses full page content to the parts that matter for a given query, preserving code blocks, API signatures, and technical detail verbatim. Use this for individual pages you already have; for end-to-end research, use intelli_research.

Codemode: `tools.intelli_extract(args)` resolves to `{ schemaVersion, operation, operationId, outcome, text, details, summary, sources, cache, related, counts: { candidates, fetched, extracted, used, late, failed, cancelled, effectivePageConcurrency }, timing: { startedUtc, elapsedMs, allWorkSettledMs, summaryReadyMs?, cutoffMs?, abortToSettledMs? }, accounting: { attempts, observedAttempts, missingAttempts, tokens, reportedCost, estimatedCost, missingTokenFields, costComplete, parentDelivery }, attempts, deadline: { enabled, reason, minimumMet } }`.
declarations.name: intelli_extract

url.description: URL of the page to extract from

declarations.description:
Deduplicate and synthesise multiple per-page extractions into a single concise summary. A saved report goes into a new run directory under .search/.intelli-v1/runs/ (or the configured cacheDir), without replacing earlier reports. A valid answer is still returned when persistence is unavailable. Use this after extracting multiple pages with intelli_extract; for end-to-end research, use intelli_research.

Codemode: `tools.intelli_collate(args)` resolves to `{ schemaVersion, operation, operationId, outcome, text, details, summary, sources, cache, related, counts: { candidates, fetched, extracted, used, late, failed, cancelled, effectivePageConcurrency }, timing: { startedUtc, elapsedMs, allWorkSettledMs, summaryReadyMs?, cutoffMs?, abortToSettledMs? }, accounting: { attempts, observedAttempts, missingAttempts, tokens, reportedCost, estimatedCost, missingTokenFields, costComplete, parentDelivery }, attempts, deadline: { enabled, reason, minimumMet } }`.
declarations.name: intelli_collate

extractions.description: Array of per-page extraction results from intelli_extract

anyOf.description: Full page content for caching (not sent to LLM)
Summary from the initial search step; accepted for compatibility, not used as synthesis evidence

declarations.description:
Search the web, fetch top results, extract relevant content from each page, and deduplicate into a concise summary. A saved report goes into a new run directory under .search/.intelli-v1/runs/ (or the configured cacheDir), without replacing earlier reports. Degraded results save no report; a valid answer is still returned when persistence is unavailable. This is the primary research tool; for quick factual lookups, use intelli_search instead.

Codemode: `tools.intelli_research(args)` resolves to `{ schemaVersion, operation, operationId, outcome, text, details, summary, sources, cache, related, counts: { candidates, fetched, extracted, used, late, failed, cancelled, effectivePageConcurrency }, timing: { startedUtc, elapsedMs, allWorkSettledMs, summaryReadyMs?, cutoffMs?, abortToSettledMs? }, accounting: { attempts, observedAttempts, missingAttempts, tokens, reportedCost, estimatedCost, missingTokenFields, costComplete, parentDelivery }, attempts, deadline: { enabled, reason, minimumMet } }`.
declarations.name: intelli_research

anyOf.description: Max URLs to fetch (default: 10, capped by settings.maxUrls)

format.definition:
start: options_source | plain_source
options_source: OPTIONS_LINE NEWLINE SOURCE
plain_source: SOURCE

OPTIONS_LINE: /[ \t]*\/\/ @options:[^\r\n]*/
NEWLINE: /\r?\n/
SOURCE: /[\s\S]+/
